title: Intention (Niyyah)
description: Form the intention in your heart to perform wudu for the sake of Allah, purifying yourself before worship. Speaking the intention aloud is optional — the dua below is a commonly taught way to voice it.
note: In the Hanafi madhhab, intention is Sunnah for wudu, not Fard — wudu is technically valid without it. The Shafi'i, Maliki, and Hanbali madhahib hold that intention is Fard.
translation: Maine Allah Ta'ala ke liye wudu karne ki niyyat ki.

title: Say Bismillah
description: Begin by saying "In the name of Allah," as taught in the Sunnah before starting wudu.
note: The narrated wording is the short "Bismillah", not the full Qur'anic Basmala. Some scholars hold naming Allah before wudu to be Wajib when not forgotten; the majority Hanafi view is Sunnah Mu'akkadah.

title: Wash the Hands
description: Wash both hands up to the wrists three times, making sure water reaches between the fingers.

title: Rinse the Mouth
description: Take water into the mouth and rinse it thoroughly, three times.
note: Sunnah Mu'akkadah in the Hanafi madhhab; some other scholars hold it to be Fard.

title: Rinse the Nose
description: Sniff water gently into the nostrils and then blow it out, three times.
note: Sunnah Mu'akkadah in the Hanafi madhhab; some other scholars hold it to be Wajib.

title: Wash the Face
description: Wash the whole face three times, from the hairline to the chin and from ear to ear.

title: Wash the Right Arm
description: Wash the right arm from the fingertips to (and including) the elbow, three times.

title: Wash the Left Arm
description: Wash the left arm from the fingertips to (and including) the elbow, three times.

title: Wipe the Head
description: With wet hands, wipe over the head once, moving from the front to the back and then back to the front.
note: Wiping at least a quarter of the head fulfils the Fard; wiping the entire head, as described here, is the Sunnah method.

title: Wipe the Ears
description: Wipe the inside of the ears with the index fingers and the outside with the thumbs, once.

title: Wash the Right Foot
description: Wash the right foot up to (and including) the ankle, three times, including between the toes.

title: Wash the Left Foot
description: Wash the left foot up to (and including) the ankle, three times, including between the toes.

title: Recite After Wudu
description: After completing wudu, it is Sunnah to bear witness to the oneness of Allah and ask to be among those who purify themselves.
note: Narrated in Sahih Muslim, with the addition asking to be among those who purify themselves narrated in Jami' at-Tirmidhi.
arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ. اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
transliteration: Ash-hadu al la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh. Allahumma-j'alni minat-tawwabina wa-j'alni minal-mutatahhirin.
translation: Main gawahi deta hoon keh Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh akela hai, uska koi shareek nahi, aur main gawahi deta hoon keh Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) uske bande aur rasool hain. Ya Allah! Mujhe tauba karne walon mein shamil farma, aur mujhe pak-saaf rehne walon mein shamil farma.
